summary: Budibase is a low-code platform designed for constructing internal tools, administrative panels, dashboards, and CRUD applications rapidly. It serves as an alternative to proprietary enterprise platforms like OutSystems, Retool, Mendix, and Appian.
goodFor: Teams looking to speed up the creation of internal business software and admin dashboards without writing every line of code from scratch.
watchOut: The software uses a proprietary licence rather than open-source terms, which may impose restrictions on commercial use or enterprise deployment depending on your organisational policies.
deployNotes: Because it runs on Node.js, Docker, and Kubernetes, you will typically need to configure persistent storage for your application state and set up a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
